answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique patent assignment chain. It rests on an assignment chain with no gaps from inventor to owner, which gives every honest agent a relic that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that an assignment chain with no gaps from inventor to owner — so privacy survives, and the bridge is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the quartz first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
